units.summary: Adds a test-case struct with an expectString field, replacing the inline anonymous table struct in TestQuantityParse. Test-only, and TestQuantityParse is re-added in another unit using the new helper, so no coverage is lost.
units.headline: Add parseQuantityTestcase struct with expected canonical string
units.reason: Test-only type definition; the removed TestQuantityParse header is re-added elsewhere in the PR using the shared table.

units.summary: The parse table becomes a function returning a fresh slice, and each case gains an expected String() output. This lets tests and benchmarks share the table without mutation leaking between uses. It affects tests only.
units.headline: Quantity parse table now a function with expected strings
units.reason: Test-only data refactor with all original inputs and expectations kept; new expectString values are additive assertions.

units.summary: The benchmark now runs one sub-benchmark per quantity using b.Loop instead of cycling through a slice. It is test-only and does not affect production behavior.
units.headline: AsApproximateFloat64 benchmark split into per-quantity sub-benchmarks
units.reason: Benchmark-only restructuring; no production code or assertions affected.
